answers.core: This is about improving the contributor/power user experience when opening lots of projects from online resources.
answers.workaround: You can write a shell script like [gd-pr-test.sh](https://gist.github.com/Calinou/9509da17ee3f3773ac6b47e5c2713c5e), but such scripts are generally not cross-platform.

title: Add a command line argument to import projects from ZIP archives (like the project manager's Import button)
